messages.author: c4196ddf236e8a8d
messages.subject: Installation problem
parts:
I have a problem with installing INLA that I hope someone can help me with.

I am using windows 7, R 2.15.1 and have installed the required packages. I downloaded the relevant INLA.zip file, chose 'install packages' (in RStudio), and selected the right file. Then I get this:

install.packages("C:/Users/LasseTK/Desktop/INLA.zip", repos = NULL)
Installing package(s) into ‘C:/Users/LasseTK/Documents/R/win-library/2.15’
(as ‘lib’ is unspecified)
Warning in install.packages :
  unable to move temporary installation ‘C:\Users\LasseTK\Documents\R\win-library\2.15\filef6445c528bd\INLA’ to ‘C:\Users\LasseTK\Documents\R\win-library\2.15\INLA’


Can anyone help me with this? 

Thanks,
Lasse

messages.author: c4196ddf236e8a8d
messages.subject: Re: Installation problem
parts:
I have found the solution: antivirus. I had to disable my antivirus program's real-time shield while making the installations. Now everything works.

Lasse
